title: A ring space station
text: Take turns rolling and flying your ship around a ring of station modules.

title: Buy and build
text: Land on a free module to buy it. Own a full set to build domes and raise the rent.

title: Charge rent
text: Anyone who lands on your module pays you rent. Deal and trade with other pilots from your phone.

title: Stay solvent
text: Run out of money and you're out. The last pilot solvent, or the richest when the clock runs out, wins.
